description.value: Mt. Waddington's Outdoors is a backcountry equipment retailer with stores in Chilliwack and Whistler, carrying premium outdoor gear across camping, hiking, climbing, paddling, and snow sports. The shop stocks high-end brands such as Arc'teryx, Blue Ice, Alpacka, and NRS, and offers gear-fitting, repair, and consultation services. A touring cyclist passing through Chilliwack may find useful camp and hiking consumables here, though no dedicated cycling section is evident.
